glosses: platform (a raised stage used for speeches and performances)
platform (a place or opportunity to express one's opinions)
platform (a particular type of operating system or environment)

examples.text: Tom trabaja en una plataforma petrolífera.
examples.en: Tom works on an oil rig.

examples.text: Ella estuvo a punto de caerse de la plataforma.
examples.en: She came close to falling off the platform.

examples.text: El próximo tren hacia el aeropuerto sale de la plataforma 2.
examples.en: The next train to the airport departs from platform 2.
